name: ESTELIN SUNSCREEN 50G – ULTRA LIGHT
short_description: Ultra-Light hydrating invisible sunscreen provides high protection against harmful UVA/UVB and sunburn, and early signs of ageing caused by sun exposure, repairing sun-induced wrinkles and fine lines. It has a non-greasy and fast-absorbing texture, and the moisturizing formula helps reduce the risk of sun allergies while moisturizing the skin.
description:
Benefits: Ultra-Light hydrating invisible sunscreen provides high protection against harmful UVA/UVB and sunburn, and early signs of aging caused by sun exposure, repairing sun-induced wrinkles and fine lines. It has a non-greasy and fast-absorbing texture, and the moisturizing formula helps reduce the risk of sun allergies while moisturizing the skin

Use For: Face & Body Sunscreen

Feature: Protection and Hevis Light Defense – Lightweight Non-Greasy – Oil Free – Water Resistant Invisible Finish – Non-White Cast

Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types

Ingredient: Aqua, Ethylhexyl palmitate, mineral oil, propylene glycol, glycerin, dimethicone, glyceryl stearate, phenoxyethanol, peg-100 stearate, octocrylene, Ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, Cetearyl alcohol, ci 77891, carbomer, triethanolamine, ceteareth-25, parfum, methylparaben, acrylates/ammonium methacrylate copolymer, chlorphenesin, niacinamide, triethoxycaprylylsilane, sodium hyaluronate, tocopherol, peg- glyceryl cocoate, methyl propanediol, hydrolyzed pearl, ethylhexylglycerin, 1,2-hexanediol, hydroxy acetophenone, ceramide

How To Use: Apply generously 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply after 40 minutes of swimming or sweating, immediately after towel drying, at least every hour. If used with other skincare products, use it as a last step in the regimen. Can be used alone or under makeup
